CHAPTER 3 · ITEM 02 / 08

Absolute and comparative advantage

Opportunity-cost ratios機會成本比率

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Calculate each producer's opportunity cost using either productivity data or time required. Express each answer in units of the other good, and use reciprocal costs consistently.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

若資料是同期間產量，X 的成本為最大 Y 除最大 X；若資料是每件時間，則為製作 X 時間除製作 Y 時間。兩種商品的成本互為倒數。

For output-per-period data, cost of X in Y equals maximum Y divided by maximum X. For time-per-unit data, divide time for X by time for Y. The reverse opportunity cost is its reciprocal.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：One pizza takes 2 hours and one drink takes 1 hour. A pizza costs 2 drinks; one drink costs 0.5 pizza. 比率互為倒數。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A can make 12 X or 4 Y daily. Opportunity cost of 1 Y? 每 Y 成本？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
